meta.build: November 2026 build: 24 CPTAC-3 bulk samples (12 PDAC, 12 adjacent pancreas, 12 patients); healthy reference Baron 2016 (9 cell types); run of 2026-11-09

fields.cellTypes: order of the 9 values of every typeExpr row and of sets.topType (same order as result.cellTypes in demo-data.js)
fields.genes: symbols of the 20,221 genes tested in the bulk comparison, in the order of the comparison table; every per-gene array below follows this order
fields.de.lfc: shrunken log2 fold change, PDAC vs adjacent pancreas (3 decimals); positive = higher in PDAC
fields.de.baseMean: mean normalized count over the 24 samples (2 decimals)
fields.de.dir: direction as on the site: 1 = higher in PDAC, -1 = lower in PDAC (adjusted p < 0.05 and shrunken fold change of at least 2-fold), 0 = neither
fields.typeExpr: per gene, 9 values in cellTypes order: mean estimated expression, log(1 + counts per 10,000), 3 decimals; null when the gene is not among the 19,949 genes shared with the healthy reference
fields.sets.id / sets.collection / sets.label: one entry per gene set shown on the site (H = Hallmark, PROGENY = PROGENy, REACTOME, WIKIPATHWAYS, GOBP = GO Biological Process); set index = position in these arrays
fields.sets.topType: index into cellTypes of the cell type with the highest mean activity of the set; null for sets shown only in the bulk comparison
fields.sets.nes / sets.padj: bulk enrichment of the set, PDAC vs adjacent pancreas: normalized enrichment score (positive = higher in PDAC) and adjusted p value; null when the set was not tested in the bulk comparison (PROGENy pathways are tested separately, see demo-data.js)
fields.geneSetsDelta: per gene, the sets that contain the gene, as ascending set indices stored as differences: first value = first set index, each next value = increase over the previous index (decode with a running sum); [] = member of no set shown
fields.leadingPos: per gene, positions (0-based) in the gene's decoded set list of the sets in whose leading-edge genes of the bulk enrichment the gene appears; [] = none
fields.kegg: per gene, ids of the site's KEGG metabolic pathways that list the gene as an enzyme gene; [] = none
fields.keggNotScored: genes with a kegg entry that were not among the genes used to estimate pathway activity; the site's pathway pages do not list them
fields.aliases: KEY -> symbol in genes, for former symbols, alias symbols and short names that point to exactly one tested gene; KEY = typed name in upper case with everything except letters and digits removed
fields.ambiguousAliases: KEY -> [symbols]: names that point to several tested genes; genes for which the name is a former official symbol come first; never resolved automatically
fields.symbolAlsoAlias: symbol -> [symbols]: the symbol is itself a tested gene and is also a former or alias name of the listed genes

definitions.lookup: Resolve a typed name in this order: (1) exact symbol in genes, ignoring case; (2) KEY of the name equal to the KEY of a symbol; (3) aliases[KEY]; (4) ambiguousAliases[KEY]: offer the listed genes, do not choose. A name found nowhere is a gene that was not tested in this build (expression too low in these samples, or the name is unknown).
definitions.decodeSets: let s = 0; const setIdx = geneSetsDelta[i].map(d => s += d); const leadingIdx = leadingPos[i].map(p => setIdx[p]);
definitions.de: Read from the published comparison table of this build (results download, comparison/bulk_differential_expression.csv); not recomputed.
definitions.typeExpr: Each estimated profile is scaled to 10,000 counts over the genes used to build the profiles, transformed with log(1 + x), and averaged over all estimated profiles of the cell type (7,198 profiles, all 24 samples). Same definition as the cell-type values already shown on the site.
definitions.geneSets: Membership uses the complete gene list of each set in the gene-set library, not only the genes used for scoring. For PROGENy a member is one of the pathway's response genes (its weight can be positive or negative).
definitions.leading: Leading-edge genes of the bulk enrichment as listed in the results download (comparison/bulk_pathway_enrichment.csv, top contributing genes); the site shows the first 15 per set.
definitions.kegg: A gene belongs to a pathway when KEGG links it, through an enzyme, to at least one reaction of the pathway as shown on the site.
definitions.aliases: HGNC complete set: former symbols, alias symbols, the approved name and alias names of at most 3 words. Genes whose symbol in this build is a former symbol are matched to their current HGNC record first.

sources.bulk: CPTAC-3 PDAC bulk RNA-seq (NCI Genomic Data Commons, data release 46.0); comparison tables from the results download of this demo
sources.estimatedProfiles: estimated single-cell profiles of the run of 2026-11-09 (7,198 profiles, 19,949 genes shared with the healthy reference)
sources.healthyReference: Baron et al., Cell Systems 2016 (GSE84133), 9 cell types
sources.geneSets: H: MSigDB 2026.2.Hs; PROGENY: saezlab/progeny @ cad6be0514c3 (v1.17.3); REACTOME: MSigDB 2026.2.Hs; WIKIPATHWAYS: MSigDB 2026.2.Hs; GOBP: MSigDB 2026.2.Hs
sources.kegg: KEGG reaction-to-gene links for human, as used for the metabolic pathways of this build
sources.names: HGNC complete set (genenames.org), 45,289 approved records, last modified 2026-10-23
